CustomField.formula:
IF( NOT(IsClosed), IF( TEXT(My_Flag_icon_number__c) = "0", IMAGE("/resource/My_Flag_Blue_Bubble", "Chat Started", 30, 30), IF( TEXT(My_Flag_icon_number__c) = "1", IMAGE("/resource/My_Flag_Yellow", "Yellow Flag", 30, 30), IF( TEXT(My_Flag_icon_number__c) = "2", IMAGE("/resource/My_Flag_Red_Flag", "Red Flag", 30, 30), IF( TEXT(My_Flag_icon_number__c) = "3", IMAGE("/resource/My_Flag_Flame", "Flame", 30, 30), "Awaiting Customer Reply" ) ) ) ), NULL )
&
IF( AND( IsClosed = TRUE, NOT(ISBLANK(EntitlementId)) ), IMAGE("/resource/My_Flag_Green_check_mark", "Complete", 30, 30), IF( AND( ISBLANK(TEXT(My_Flag_icon_number__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(EntitlementId)), IsClosed = FALSE ), IMAGE("/resource/My_Flag_Red_Cross_mark", "NO ENTITLEMENT ASSIGNED", 30, 30), "" ) )
CustomField.label: Case Flag
